{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|Various records note that the first Matukai was a human female from the world of Karvoss II who discovered her ability to touch the Force while practicing a form of meditative martial arts.|[[Tionne Solusar]], ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''|<ref name="JvS" />}}
A '''form''' of [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] existed<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> at some point following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="GSW">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] states that the form of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] was practiced by a [[Unidentified Human female (Matukai)|Human female]] who would eventually found the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] sect. ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'' establishes that the [[Gender/Legends|female]] was alive at some point following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], so the martial arts form must have also existed by that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> of [[3996 BBY]].
